title: Imaginary Invention · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Imaginary Invention · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose an everyday problem that needs no dangerous solution. The lead describes an imaginary invention and tells a short story about how it helps. The group can identify the problem, invention and result. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Imaginary Invention, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group can identify the problem, invention and result.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group can identify the problem, invention and result.
